mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_identity_service_principal (id, issuer, realm, status, security_epoch, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{issuer}, #{realm}, #{status}, #{securityEpoch}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.issuer, p.realm, p.status, p.security_epoch, p.created_at FROM ainer_identity_service_principal p INNER JOIN ainer_identity_oauth_client_binding b ON b.principal_id = p.id WHERE b.client_id = #{clientId} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE'
